rationale: The claim accurately reflects the explicit scope exclusions in DS.AI.010(d)(1) and (2) of EASA NPA 2025-07(B). While the challenge correctly notes that classifying a specific DAA function under this exclusion requires a formal aircraft-level failure-condition allocation, the claim remains factually supported regarding the document's boundary for the most demanding flight-critical cases.
limitations: Applying the exclusion to a specific real-world DAA function requires a formal aircraft-level safety assessment and failure-condition allocation.
